top_signals.title: Trump Iran Messaging 'Extremely Reckless,' Says Rep. Madeleine Dean
top_signals.summary: Pennsylvania Democrat Madeleine Dean, who sits on the House Foreign Affairs Committee, said the US and its Middle Eastern allies 'are all less safe as a result of this war in Iran' and called the president's messaging around the war 'extremely reckless.' The congresswoman also weighed in on the potential for increased sanctions against Russia, saying that she does not think that the bill will come to a vote this week and that she is wary of the increased tariff authority it would give President Trump, despite her calls for support for Ukraine.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Senegal to Rework Debt as It Reaches New IMF Deal
top_signals.summary: Senegal’s eurobonds fell on Tuesday after the government said it will move forward with a “debt treatment” under the Group of 20’s Common Framework and agreed a new $2.2 billion program with the International Monetary Fund.
